text:
maria: Heads up — eu-south apiserver 503s starting ~18:12UTC. Controller-manager leader flips and attach queue for GPU nodes spiking. Looks correlated with high etcd sync io on the masters.

sam: seeing it too. graphs show etcd write latency up ~3-4x around 18:10. provisioner backlog for rtx-pools growing.

lee: logs (tail):
```
I0319 18:11:45.123 controller.go:456] failed to attach GPU: timeout waiting for attach, retrying
W0319 18:11:46.987 etcd/store.go:321] sync io stall: write duration 2.4s
E0319 18:11:48.000 apiserver/handler.go:78] 503 response for /watch?resource=pods
```

jordan: ops-bot shows master nvme queue saturation on two hosts (master-05, master-07). nvme util ~98%. I/O ops/sec jumped.

anya: any recent changes to compaction or snapshot schedule?

maria: we changed snapshot defrag window last night to run across masters -> maybe overlapping heavy GC + provisioning churn.

sam: quick mitigation: throttling controller-manager resync and leader-election heartbeat could reduce write pressure. Also can we pause scheduled snapshot/defrag for 30m?

lee: agreed. patch to reduce resync: `--controllersync-period=10m` for controller-manager, and bump leader-elect lease to 60s? that'll reduce churn but increases failover time.

jordan: I'm going to cordon master-07 for controlplane upgrade to NVMe firmware (it shows high SMART error count). Will drain with `kubectl drain master-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` but might flip leader again.

maria: do it but mark expected downtime in ops channel. We need to avoid cascading GPU attach timeouts.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0319-114. Priority: high. Notified on-call.

anya: cost question — if we pin more reserved capacity for GPUs in eu-south to avoid burst attach spikes, that's extra monthly spend. Do we prefer short-term fix or SRE controlplane hardening?

sam: short-term: harden control plane (throttle snapshots, increase lease, delay resync). Long-term: add small hot spare NVMe pool for masters or move etcd to larger iops disks. Reserving GPUs costs more but doesn't help master IO.

lee: deploying config change now: reduced snapshot defrag schedule, controller-manager flag update to 10m. rolling restart on cm pods in 3m.

maria: after change, etcd write latency trending down. attach queue length decreased from 42 -> 6 in 15m. apiserver 5xxs reduced.

jordan: master-07 cordon/drain started, will replace NVMe. ETA 45m.

anya: capturing decision — invest in master disk IOPS improvements in next quarter vs. temporary scheduling tweaks now. I'll surface to infra-planning.

maria: good. next steps: 1) let master replacement finish, 2) run controlled restore of snapshot schedule after 24h, 3) consider storage class upgrade for etcd with higher iops.

sam: filing follow-up ticket for cost vs reliability analysis (SRE-1289).

lee: thumbs up. closing here but will post updates to incidents channel. :thumbsup:
